title: Two tasks waiting for each other's event fail the run at runtime
purpose: Run a program whose tasks deadlock and observe the failure and the output before it.

stderr.text: RuntimeError: async main cannot complete: no task can make progress

provenance.origin: authored for #342; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #342: no task is ready and nothing external can wake one; the run fails with a runtime error and a nonzero status after the output already written.
